servicesHeading: Our Complete Services for Patients at Bumrungrad International Hospital
servicesIntro: At Discover International Medical Service (DIMS), We provide a wide range of services for patients visiting Bumrungrad International Hospital. Here’s a quick overview of what we can help you with:

services.name: Schedule Doctor Appointment
services.description: We help you book appointments with top doctors at Bumrungrad Hospital, so you get the care you need quickly.

services.name: Thailand Visa Processing
services.description: We make getting your Thailand visa easy, handling all the paperwork so you can focus on your treatment.

services.name: Order Medicine
services.description: We help you order medicine from Thailand and ensure it arrives safely and on time for your treatment.

services.name: Medical Records
services.description: We assist with transferring your medical records to Bumrungrad Hospital, making sure your doctors have all the information.

services.name: Telemedicine
services.description: You can connect with expert doctors at Bumrungrad through telemedicine for consultations and follow-up care, no matter where you are.

services.name: Air Ambulance Service
services.description: If you need urgent medical care, we arrange fast and safe air ambulance transport to Bumrungrad International Hospital.

services.name: Air Ticket
services.description: We help you book international flights to Thailand for medical treatment, ensuring smooth and affordable travel.

services.name: Airport Transfer Service
services.description: We provide airport pick-up and drop-off services, making your travel to and from the hospital easy and comfortable.

services.name: Admission On Arrival
services.description: We assist with your direct hospital admission upon arrival, so you can start your treatment without any delays.

services.name: Thai Local Accommodation
services.description: We help you find comfortable and safe accommodation near the hospital, making your stay in Thailand relaxing and convenient.

services.name: Language Interpreter
services.description: We provide language interpreters to help you communicate easily with your doctors and medical team during your treatment.

services.name: Transfer Money for Treatment
services.description: We assist in transferring money for your medical treatment, making sure your payment reaches the hospital safely and quickly.

closingHeading: Lets make your medical trip to Bumrungrad a seamless experience!
closingText: At DIMS, We are committed to providing you with seamless access to the best healthcare at Bumrungrad International Hospital. Whether you are seeking treatment for a chronic condition, undergoing surgery, or just looking for a second opinion, Our team is here to guide you every step of the way. Our goal is to simplify the process of medical travel, handling the logistics so that you can focus on your health and recovery. By partnering with Bumrungrad International Hospital, we ensure that you receive the highest quality care in one of the world's Top medical destinations.
